seepers.configuration.title: Seepers Settings
seepers.configuration.verboseLogging.too: Log extra diagnostic messages from Seepers systems.
seepers.configuration.logNetwork.tooltip: Log Seepers packets received by the client.
seepers.configuration.debugCommands.tool: Enable /seepers debug commands for operators (permission level 2).
seepers.configuration.darkness.tooltip: True darkness (applied on clients; set by the server)
seepers.configuration.blackLightLevel.to: Light levels up to this value render completely black. Visible radius of a light source = its level - this - 1.
seepers.configuration.maxGamma.tooltip: Upper limit for the Brightness (gamma) video option: 0.0 = Moody, 1.0 = Bright.
seepers.configuration.nightVisionBrighte: If off, the Night Vision effect still exists but does not brighten the world.
seepers.configuration.disableNaturalHost: Block natural spawning of hostile mobs (also patrols and phantoms). Exceptions: entity tag #seepers:natural_spawn_exempt.
seepers.configuration.light.tooltip: Block light. Changes apply where light is recomputed (new chunks, changed blocks).
seepers.configuration.uncategorizedMax.t: Maximum light level of emitting blocks that are in no light category tag (e.g. from other mods).
Light multiplier for waterlogged blocks (except tag #seepers:light/no_water_dimming).
seepers.configuration.waterAbsorption.to: Light levels lost per block of water (vanilla: 1).
seepers.configuration.categories.tooltip: Light level of each tag #seepers:light/<name> as [overworld, nether, end]; candle: [1, 2, 3, 4 candles].
seepers.configuration.fog.tooltip: Fog density field. Density is in halvings: each +1 halves how far you can see.
seepers.configuration.layers.tooltip: Dense fog layers at varying heights.
seepers.configuration.weather.tooltip: Extra fog in rain and thunderstorms.
seepers.configuration.distortion.tooltip: Fog grows with distortion (level k where zone k starts).
seepers.configuration.fog.scale.tooltip: Size of the noise features, blocks.
seepers.configuration.fog.driftBlocksPer: Blocks per minute layers and pockets drift.
seepers.configuration.fog.clearing.toolt: How clear a pocket is at its core (0..1).
seepers.configuration.fog.intervalMinDay: Minimum time between storms, game days.
seepers.configuration.fog.intervalMaxDay: Maximum time between storms, game days.
seepers.configuration.fog.warningSeconds: Fog thickens gradually for this long before a storm.
seepers.configuration.fog.thunder.toolti: Extra density in a thunderstorm (on top of rain).
seepers.configuration.fog.height.tooltip: Height of the dense layer above open water, blocks.
seepers.configuration.fogCellsPerTick.to: Fog grid cells recomputed per client tick (the grid around the player has ~8000 cells).
seepers.configuration.fog.nearFraction.t: Fog starts at this fraction of the visibility distance.
seepers.configuration.fog.haloStrength.t: How much the fog lightens when you stand in light (0 = never).
seepers.configuration.fog.underwaterVisi: Blocks visible under water (more with water vision and conduit power).
seepers.configuration.fog.renderDistance: Fog always ends this many blocks before the render distance.
seepers.configuration.heat.tooltip: Heat clears fog around its sources (tags #seepers:heat/<name>).
seepers.configuration.heat.warmupSeconds: Seconds until a newly lit source clears fog fully.
seepers.configuration.heat.cooldownSecon: Seconds for the fog to return after a source goes out (inertia).
seepers.configuration.heat.maxSourcesPer: Heat sources tracked per chunk (lava lakes and the like are capped).
seepers.configuration.heat.strength.tool: Fog density cleared at the source (halvings).
seepers.configuration.heat.radius.toolti: Radius of the heated area, blocks.
seepers.configuration.rooms.tooltip: Closed rooms keep fog out; leaks let it creep back in.
seepers.configuration.rooms.maxVolume.to: Largest room, in air blocks; bigger spaces count as open.
Seconds for fog to fill a reference-size room through one leak; more leaks per volume - faster.
seepers.configuration.rooms.clearSeconds: Seconds for fog to clear after a room is closed.
seepers.configuration.rooms.referenceVol: Room volume (blocks) for which one leak takes fillSeconds.
seepers.configuration.rooms.recheckTicks: Ticks between room checks around players.
commands.seepers.debug.storage.chunk: Chunk %s: player blocks %s, fire sources %s (last check %s), anomaly blasted %s / chiseled %s
commands.seepers.debug.storage.dimension: Dimension %s: active chunks %s (this one: %s), lidar points %s from %s sources
commands.seepers.debug.storage.global: World: full base copies %s, remains %s, players with lives %s; your lives %s, current tag %s
commands.seepers.debug.light: Light at %s: block %s, sky %s; %s — category %s, emits %s here, opacity %s
commands.seepers.debug.fog.total: Fog at %s: density %s (heat and other writers %s), visibility %s blocks
commands.seepers.debug.fog.parts: base %s + layers %s + wave %s + weather %s + water %s + distortion %s; pockets x%s; storm +%s
commands.seepers.debug.fog.storm_next: Next storm in %s min, lasts %s min (starts at day time %s)
commands.seepers.debug.fog.client: Fog at %s: server %s, client direct %s, client grid %s
commands.seepers.debug.fog.bench: Fog bench: %s samples, %s us per sample (mean density %s)
commands.seepers.debug.room.none: No room at %s (open space or solid); last fill %s ms
commands.seepers.debug.room.found: Room at %s: %s, volume %s, leaks %s, outside fog %s%%, last fill %s ms
seepers.configuration.fires.tooltip: Fog blows out torches, breaks campfires and puts out candles (tags #seepers:fire/*). Lanterns are safe.
seepers.configuration.fires.blowOutStart: Fog density (with heat and rooms) at the fire below which it is safe.
Density from which every check puts the fire out; the chance grows linearly from the safe density.
seepers.configuration.fires.checkSeconds: Seconds between checks of each fire near players.
seepers.configuration.fires.maxChecksPer: Fog samples per tick for fire checks; the rest wait for the next tick.
commands.seepers.debug.fire.found: %s at %s: %s, fog %s, chance per check %s%%; chunk has %s fires, last checked %s ticks ago
seepers.configuration.points.tooltip: Point cloud (touch, later cane and lidar)
seepers.configuration.points.size.toolti: Point diameter in blocks; points shrink with distance.
seepers.configuration.points.minPixels.t: Far points never get smaller than this many pixels.
seepers.configuration.points.lightFadeSt: Block light at which surface points start to fade (the surface becomes visible).
seepers.configuration.points.lightFadeEn: Block light at which surface points are gone.
seepers.configuration.touch.tooltip: Touch: the first sense, drawn as points. Balance values for difficulty presets.
seepers.configuration.touch.pointLimit.t: Touch points kept at once; the oldest go first. Lidar upgrades do not raise it.
seepers.configuration.touch.pointLifetim: Seconds a touch point lasts; it fades over the last third.
commands.seepers.points.test: Added %s points on %s faces in %s ms
commands.seepers.points.stats: Points: %s (touch %s/%s, debug %s); sections %s with buffers %s; rebuilt %s sections in %s ms last second; draw %s ms per frame; %s FPS
commands.seepers.points.disabled: Point debug commands need debug commands enabled on the server and operator rights
seepers.configuration.touch.warmHeat.too: Heat (fog density cleared by heat sources) from which a surface feels warm.
seepers.configuration.touch.handReach.to: How far a click reaches with the hand, blocks.
seepers.configuration.touch.handConeDegr: Full angle of the cone a click feels along the view, degrees.
seepers.configuration.touch.handClicksPe: Most clicks per second that feel; faster ones are ignored.
seepers.configuration.touch.lavaDamage.t: Damage for touching lava with the hand (no fire), at most once a second.
seepers.touch.hint.unbound: The attack key is not bound: bind it to feel around
seepers.configuration.touch.feetRadius.t: Floor felt by the feet around a walking or crouching player, blocks (running: only underfoot).
seepers.configuration.touchCaption.toolt: What the hand felt, shown on screen
seepers.configuration.touchCaption.enabl: Show what the hand felt (block name and material).
seepers.configuration.cane.tooltip: Cane: taps along the view, sweeps on the floor ahead.
seepers.configuration.cane.reach.tooltip: How far an aimed tap reaches, blocks.
seepers.configuration.cane.sweepMin.tool: Nearest floor a sweep taps, blocks ahead.
seepers.configuration.cane.sweepMax.tool: Farthest floor a sweep taps, blocks ahead.
seepers.configuration.cane.sweepTicks.to: Ticks between sweeps (6 = about 3 a second).
seepers.configuration.cane.pointLimit.to: Cane points kept at once; the oldest go first.
seepers.configuration.cane.pointLifetime: Seconds a cane point lasts; it fades over the last third.
Width of the fan a sweep scans straight ahead, degrees.
seepers.configuration.cane.sweepRays.too: Rays (points) per sweep, floor to knee.
seepers.configuration.exemptMaxNearby.to: Exempt hostiles (drowned) that may spawn naturally: at most this many within the radius.
seepers.configuration.exemptRadius.toolt: Radius for the exempt hostile limit, blocks.
Chance that a natural spawn attempt of an exempt hostile goes ahead (slows refilling).
seepers.configuration.cane.silhouetteSec: Seconds a mob's silhouette lasts after a blow (it fades over the last third).
seepers.configuration.cane.lavaBurn.tool: Share of a wooden cane's full durability lost when it touches lava (an iron tip does not burn).
seepers.configuration.renderDistance.too: Automatic render distance: from the minimum up to the slider, never past the server.
seepers.configuration.renderDistance.aut: Lower the render distance on steady lag and raise it back when the game keeps up. The video settings slider is the ceiling.
seepers.configuration.renderDistance.smo: Frame rate is averaged over this many seconds; single hitches do not count.
seepers.configuration.renderDistance.set: After any change, measurements are ignored this long (rebuilding the world mesh is a hitch itself).
seepers.configuration.renderDistance.rai: The distance grows by at most one chunk this often.
seepers.configuration.renderDistance.tps: Server ticks per second (20 = no lag) below which the distance drops. Checked first.
The distance grows only while the server keeps at least this TPS.
seepers.configuration.renderDistance.fps: Average frames per second below which the distance drops.
The distance grows only above this average frame rate (lowered to fit a frame rate limit).
seepers.renderDistance.caption: %s (auto: %s)
seepers.configuration.renderDistance.mov: On the move at most, chunks
On the move the distance stays at most this many chunks (new chunks keep loading).
seepers.configuration.renderDistance.sti: Standing this long counts as standing still: the distance may grow up to the slider.
Standing still, the distance grows by one chunk this often.
seepers.configuration.diagnostics.toolti: Keep logs/seepers-diagnostics.log (system, frame rate, warnings; personal data replaced). /seepers report packs it for sending.
commands.seepers.report.done: Report saved (no personal data): %s — click to open the folder, then send the file.
